description:
Candidate Kim Chang-sik is not himself. Or perhaps it would make more sense to say that an ordinary, non-powered candidate at the prestigious Hero Academy is none other than Ha Jin-seok, the world’s greatest villain, reincarnated. When his initial plan of lying low fails, Jin-seok, A.K.A Chang-sik, starts changing the course of history. However, powerful people are beginning to take notice… And just as things are about to get precarious, instead of backing down, Chang-sik decides to dive headfirst into danger! Will he emerge victorious? Or be devoured?
